newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium seeks 54 bln Bfr from '97/98 state notes.
newsitem.headline: Belgium seeks 54 bln Bfr from '97/98 state notes.

text.p: Belgium hopes to raise 54 billion Belgian francs over the next 12 months from the issue of a new series of state notes aimed at retail investors, Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt said on Thursday.
The first of four issues will take place on May 26, he said, declining to give details. The issue will be priced on Friday.
In 1996/97, the first year the notes were issued, the Treasury had hoped to garner 80 billion francs but succeeded in raising only 53 billion.
Maystadt said, however, he was pleased by how the issues had gone, noting they came against a background of rapidly falling market interest rates which discouraged investors from fixed-rate products.
Maystadt said the Treasury had accepted applications to sell the notes from 29 banks and brokerages, down from 32 in 1996/97.
They will be paid an average commission of 1.18 percent on the notes they succeed in placing.
